svg.title: Runtime and workflows
svg.desc: Command: runtime [--reclaim], What it does: Scheduler/queue/admission/memory-pressure counters and ownership. Memory covers the daemon only.; Command: tasks, What it does: Pending jobs and last 128 completion records, without command arguments.; Command: cancel <id>, What it does: Interrupt a runtime request with matching agent/task; already-dispatched JavaScript can continue, and side effects cannot be undone.; Command: lease [--seconds n] [--release], What it does: Acquire/renew/release a tab's cooperating agent/task ownership. Requires --agent.; Command: batch <steps>, What it does: Execute a JSON array of 1–64 steps with optional before/after conditions; stop on failure, no automatic retry.; Command: workflow <file> --checkpoint <path>, What it does: Parameterized JSON steps and atomic checkpoints; --vars, --resume, explicit --resolve verified or retry for uncertain steps.; Command: resources <preset>, What it does: lean, balanced or visual; tab rules persist until changed, including after task completion. --reload --until JS restores previous rules on readiness failure; interruption can leave applied rules in place.; Command: http <url>, What it does: Bounded public UTF-8 HTTP without a WebKit tab, JavaScript or profile cookies; --max is a byte budget.
